metadata.constitutional_targets: Art. 3.1.5 (L_min), Art. 3.1.6 (Tier 1 Autarkic Closure), Art. 3.3 (Tier 1 basket), Art. 3.5.2 (reserves follow audit gaps)
metadata.calibration_status: ILLUSTRATIVE — uncalibrated. Rows/columns 0-11 are copied unchanged from v1 (no documented provenance). Sectors 12-13, the import-dependence vector, the installed-capacity vector and the primary-resource block are new ILLUSTRATIVE scenario values. See simone/data/calibration_sources.md section 5.
metadata.description: 14-sector physical Leontief input-output model for one N = 300 node. Changes vs v1 (SIM-QA-10 follow-ups): shelter (structural timber) re-tagged Tier 1 per Art. 3.3; new Tier 1 primary healthcare sector; new Tier 3 discretionary sector; import-dependence vector; installed capacity vector; local primary-resource coefficients and ceilings; reserve form per sector for Art. 3.5.2. Hawkins-Simon values are recomputed by the test suite, not trusted from this file.

sectors.name: Shelter: C24 Structural Timber & Birch Plywood (re-tagged Tier 1, Art. 3.3)
FabLab CNC Router & 3D Printing Run Time

technical_coefficients_matrix_A.comment: Column j represents direct physical inputs required to produce 1 unit of gross output j. Block [0:11, 0:11] is identical to v1. Columns 12-13 are ILLUSTRATIVE. Rows 12-13 are zero (healthcare and Tier 3 output are not inputs to other sectors), so rho(A) is unchanged from v1.

per_capita_daily_final_demand.comment: Final demand per person per day. Entries 0-11 copied from v1 'per_capita_daily_tier1_baseline' (note: v1 mixes tiers despite the key name). healthcare_care_h and discretionary_t3_h are ILLUSTRATIVE.

import_dependence_m.comment: ILLUSTRATIVE — uncalibrated. Fraction of each sector's installed capacity that cannot operate when external inputs are zero (imported consumables, parts, reagents). Sectors 0-11 reuse the SIM-QA-10 'central' scenario assumption; 12-13 are new assumptions. Used by autarkic_closure_audit: c_local = installed_capacity .* (1 .- m).

installed_capacity_per_day.comment: ILLUSTRATIVE — uncalibrated. Maximum gross output per day of the installed local capital stock (N = 300), set at roughly 1.25 x baseline gross output x = (I-A)^-1 d and rounded. Not derived from any surveyed site.

primary_resources.comment: ILLUSTRATIVE — order-of-magnitude only, uncalibrated. Local primary resource use r = R x must stay within the renewable ceiling (Art. 3.1.4). Coefficients: raw water drawn per unit output; land occupied per unit of daily output (typical temperate yields: ~1,000 kcal/m2/yr staples, ~3 kg/m2/yr vegetables, ~2.25 t/ha/yr timber increment).
